summary: Frontend-only smoke of Kinntegra lift-and-shift (Angular -> FastAPI proxy -> Node -> Azure SQL). All 5 requested scenarios PASSED: preview URL loads /signin with Kinntegra branding, invalid login shows 'Invalid email or password' modal, valid SUPERADMIN/Password@123 reveals PIN step, PIN 123456 navigates to /leads, and /leads renders real DB data (16 total leads, sidebar with Dashboard/Transactions/Trade Logs/Client/Lead Management/Admin, Super Admin user badge with 1634 notifications count). End-to-end Angular -> proxy -> Node -> Azure SQL chain verified in the browser.

issues: Label reads 'PAN NO' for the User ID field though the field accepts SUPERADMIN (non-PAN). Cosmetic/UX label mismatch inherited from legacy code, not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: Legacy Angular app has no data-testid attributes on interactive elements; if future automated regression is expected, adding data-testid on user-id/password/user-pin inputs and SIGN IN buttons would harden tests. Not required for lift-and-shift.
FastAPI proxy in /app/backend/server.py forwards everything to Node on 127.0.0.1:8080 - confirmed working; no changes made.
test_credentials: SUPERADMIN / Password@123 / PIN 123456 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) - VALID against live Azure SQL
seed_data_creation: None (live DB with real data used as-is)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow is stable. Preview URL: https://emergent-handover-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Use input[name='user-id'], input[name='password'], then wait ~4-5s, input[name='user-pin'] appears, click visible button:has-text('SIGN IN'). Landing = /leads with real data. After a failed login an ngb-modal-window overlays the form and MUST be dismissed (click 'OK') before another attempt - this intercepts pointer events on the SIGN IN button, so tests must always start on a fresh page or close the modal.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found for the requested flows.
